The '''Personal Luxury Yacht 3500''' or '''PLY-3500''' was a type of luxury [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. [[Holostar]] [[Javul Charn]]'s ''[[Nova's Heart]]'' was one such vessel.
